verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents request rate limiting with fixed or sliding windows (e.g. 100 requests per 60 seconds), explicitly framed as preventing expensive bills. Dynamic Routing claims it can restrict each user, project or team with budget and rate limits and enforce quotas, so spend guardrails per segment are plausible. However, the evidence never shows issuing a dedicated key per agent, and the budget enforcement mechanics (hard dollar caps, what happens at the cap) appear only as one-line claims. missing for 10: per-agent key issuance scoped to its own limits, detailed documentation of budget-cap enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.
